2. SCOPE OF WORK EXECUTED
Water Treatment works for Lakshya Engineering & Construction completed 2022.
The work was carried out under site conditions that included hard rock
encountered below the founding level over part of the alignment. The agency
organised its resources around this without recourse to the department for
additional assistance, and the programme was re-sequenced locally to keep the
critical path intact.
An extension of time was granted during execution on account of an extended
monsoon which suspended earthwork for several weeks. The delay was examined by
this office and held to be beyond the agency's control; no compensation was
claimed and none has been paid.
The above work was executed under the supervision of the undersigned in
accordance with the approved drawings, specifications, and the terms and
conditions of the contract. The work has been completed in all respects and has
been got inspected by the Engineer-in-Chief / Superintending Engineer.

3. QUALITY ASSESSMENT
The overall quality of the completed work is graded Good. Workmanship was
satisfactory after remedial work on the first pour, and a joint inspection was
held before final measurement. Materials were drawn from approved sources and
the test results filed with this office were within the limits prescribed in the
contract specification.

5. DEFICIENCY / OBSERVATION LIST
At the time of taking over, kerb alignment corrected over a 40 m stretch after
joint inspection. Regarding site safety, one first-aid case was recorded and
closed with a toolbox briefing. The agency's conduct during the contract is
recorded as cooperative, with weekly progress reporting maintained without
prompting.
Nil. No major deficiencies observed during the final inspection carried out on
2022-12-16. All minor observations pointed out during the interim inspections
have been rectified to the satisfaction of the inspecting authority.
6. RECOMMENDATION
Having satisfied myself as to the quantity and quality of the work executed, and
on the basis of the joint measurements recorded in the measurement book, I
certify the work complete and recommend release of the balance payment together
with the retention money due on expiry of the defect liability period. Certified
by A. Chaudhary, Project Director.
The agency attended to all observations raised during execution and the work was
taken over on satisfactory completion of the final inspection.
This certificate is issued for the sole purpose of recording completion of the above work and does
not absolve the contractor of any obligations under the contract, including the defect liability
period.
